experimental_design_defects: Model is Qwen3-0.6B Q8, not representative of general-purpose frontier LLM writing competence.
All three B/A/K arms shared same 0.6B weakness; ranking between two obviously invalid outputs does not estimate useful naturalness.
System prompt explicitly listed forbidden output scaffold words, allowing possible negative-instruction priming; causality not isolated.
KRC prompt carried JSON-like symbols and longer instructions, not a clean typed-structure ablation.
Five factual sentences plus 240–400 character target can induce repetition, padding, and invention.
Automatic critic counted surface features and paragraphs but did not robustly establish source entailment, grammar or discourse quality.

corrected_protocol.before_human: Enforce a decoder competence floor (ordinary coherent Korean passage with correct factual relations) on new sources. If baseline fails, do not recruit readers or assign quality scores.
corrected_protocol.independent_semantics: Must separately identify negation, agent/action, comparison direction, source uncertainty and illicit causal upgrades.
corrected_protocol.human_review: CANCELLED_FOR_V01; no replacement until model demonstrates minimum aptitude and study can ask discriminating linguistic questions.
corrected_protocol.scientific_ceiling: The invalidity court rejects v0.1 as a naturalness evaluation instrument; it does not imply all Korean writing hypotheses or the KRC concept are false.

user_goals: Produce logically faithful, context-appropriate Korean prose that is less stereotypically AI-like than a credible general model baseline. Quality means usable prose, not strings that escape detection.
